verifier_note: Every url re-opened with the kit's fetcher (states/net.py) and the PVA Directory PDF read with ballot/pdftext.py. Each finding matches its page and is tied to its 2026 race by the county or district and the office. Donald K Pearson: Ohio County's Coroner page names 'Donnie Pearson - Deputy Coroner' under the coroner; same county and the same office he seeks, and Donnie is a form of Donald, so kept. While checking, one constable's and one school district's address line were printed to the verifier's own output by a filter that missed them; nothing was stored.
note: The session's shared web-search allowance was already used up when this part began, so everything here was read directly from government sites with the kit's fetcher (and WebFetch). Not reachable or refused: Harlan, Rowan and Floyd county hosts did not resolve; Knott and Perry county sites answer with a CAPTCHA page (not requested further); the Rowan County Clerk's site answers 403; Ballotpedia returns an empty page; Daviess County, Taylor County, Mount Washington, Campbell County Schools and Jeffersontown pages load their lists by script or reset the connection. Checked and not holding the office sought: Brandon Embry (Butler County's 4th District magistrate is another person), Matthew Williams (not among Monroe County's magistrates), Melissa Fannin Phelps (Martin County's County Attorney page names another person), Lillian Brents (not on Jefferson County's board list), Shari Kilmer (not on Florence's council list; Boone County Democrats list her among their 2026 candidates, already kept in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json as support, not an endorsement), Chris Furlong (Barren County's elected officials page lists no constables). Rachel Roarx and Karen A. Berg are sitting legislators with record pages; no campaign website was found for either without search (the Legislature's profile gives none). Donald K Pearson: Ohio County's Coroner page names 'Donnie Pearson - Deputy Coroner' (same county and office line; the verifier should judge the name). While reading magistrate and constable lists, a few office and home address lines of other officials were printed to this agent's output before the filter was tightened; nothing was stored.
